minimum_engineering_change: Ledger and rolling estimator implemented locally; reliable five-way inference still requires stronger PIT features distinguishing neighboring EV bands, more independent matured dates within stable regimes, and timely observable regime-change predictors. Null has no identifying signal by design.
limitations: Frozen algorithm updates only with strictly matured realized outcomes; evaluation truth and oracle regimes never enter inference.
Synthetic noisy measurements are artificially informative in learnable/misleading; no historical or native-alpha claim.
Unannounced reversal is detectable only after delayed noisy outcomes; rolling detection cannot guarantee immediate safety.
EV ground truth is evaluator-only generative conditional mean; realized outcome tiers also reported separately.
SE intervals are date-clustered diagnostics; not formal simultaneous/dependence-robust coverage.
No terminal liquidation; NAV includes open positions and receivables, costs reported on executed fills.
Portfolio tests cover 126 sessions, four seeds; no statistical robustness claim.
Native funded-exit scale gates may prevent every scaled add; no fabricated fills.

The DGP grosses up one-session net EV by round-trip costs. A portfolio holding across multiple signals pays costs less frequently and can earn positive drift even with null signals; null baseline profits are not evidence of quality recognition. Portfolio holding horizons differ from one-session label horizons.
Online monitoring uses matured evaluation realized returns, never latent evaluation labels; evaluation is prequential, not a static frozen-fit holdout.
No pre-change observable feature identifies the unannounced reversal. Drift alarm and recovery lag are unavoidable.
Risk gates use empirical fifth percentile outcomes and native candidate modeled risk; neither guarantees realized loss bounds.

baseline_scope: Existing MTS net-EV admission and EV-ranked cash queue at 10% cap, on harmonized experiment ENTER/HOLD/EXIT proposals. Not a byte-identical rerun of the older planted-tape native switching policy; tape, horizon and proposal logic differ.

preregistration_metadata_discrepancy.description: Version 2 method and online_evaluation supersede inherited static confidence/train/calibration metadata. Inclusive implementation windows contain 40 older and up to 21 recent dates (61 total), and 9 recent drift dates, versus nominal 40/20/8 wording. Exact bounds were frozen in source before evaluation; no post-evaluation repair or tuning performed.

prior_scaling_robustness.interpretation: Prior null scaling increased tails; use actual native funded evidence plus local calibration and independent risk clipping. No scaling-success claim from cap alone.
